subject: Access Orchestra: Onramp Activation Slate
messages:
From: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@novacare.io>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novacare IT <it@novacare.io>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC MAP and connectivity items

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. The leadership team liked the latency/cost breakdown and we want to move forward with a 6-week evaluation. Before we lock dates, can you send a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that includes the onboarding checkpoints for:

- org / tenant setup (who creates the account and svc accounts)
- API key provisioning and recommended scopes (ephemeral vs long-lived)
- IP allowlist entries we need to add (sample CIDR format)
- VPC peering steps and required AWS/GCP identifiers

High-level ask: if we can get a MAP and the connectivity templates by COB this week we can hit a target start on Monday 6/17.

Also: two compliance questions — do you have a standard data retention note for POC logs, and can we get a SOC2 evidence checklist for the evaluation? If you prefer, we can cover those on the kickoff call.

Proposed 30m kickoff window: Tue 6/11 10:00–10:30 PT. Does that work?

Appreciate it — Alyssa

--
Alyssa Romero
Director, IT Operations | Novacare
alyssa@novacare.io
+1 (415) 555-0149

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@novacare.io>
Cc: Novacare IT <it@novacare.io>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Jun 2029 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC MAP and connectivity items

On Mon, Jun 10, 2029 at 9:02 AM Alyssa Romero <alyssa@novacare.io> wrote:
> Thanks again for the demo last week. The leadership team liked the latency/cost breakdown and we want to move forward with a 6-week evaluation. Before we lock dates, can you send a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that includes the onboarding checkpoints for: 
> - org / tenant setup (who creates the account and svc accounts)
> - API key provisioning and recommended scopes (ephemeral vs long-lived)
> - IP allowlist entries we need to add (sample CIDR format)
> - VPC peering steps and required AWS/GCP identifiers
>
> High-level ask: if we can get a MAP and the connectivity templates by COB this week we can hit a target start on Monday 6/17.

Hi Alyssa — great to hear the team is aligned. I attached a clean MAP slide (MAP-activation-slides.pdf) and two quick templates: an "onramp-api-key-instructions.md" with recommended key types and scopes, and a VPC peering checklist (vpc-peering-template.pdf).

Summary of next steps from our side (proposed):
1) Redwood to create a sandbox org placeholder for Novacare (we'll send an invite to your SSO admin). Owner: Tessa — ETA 6/12 EOD.
2) API keys: we recommend issuing an ephemeral key for initial testing + one long-lived read-only key for embeddings/metric pulls. See attached instructions. Owner: Ben — ETA 6/13 AM.
3) IP allowlist / egress: we provide a sample CIDR list; you can add to your outbound rules. Please confirm the public egress IPs you want to allow. Owner: Novacare IT — requested by 6/14.
4) VPC peering: we support peering to both AWS and GCP. The template lists the required VPC IDs, project numbers, and required IAM roles. Owner: Novacare IT + Redwood networking — kickoff 6/14 if you want to proceed.

Compliance items: we'll attach our evaluation SOC2 evidence stub at kickoff and include a concise data retention note for POC logs (default 30 days, adjustable). Neha will own the compliance checklist.

Proposed kickoff: Tue 6/11 10:00 PT — happy to take that slot. If confirmed, I'll send a calendar invite with the MAP and template links.

Let me know if you want tighter timelines.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
phone: (650) 555-0199
attachments: MAP-activation-slides.pdf, onramp-api-key-instructions.md, vpc-peering-template.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Jun 2029 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC MAP and connectivity items (internal)

Tessa / Ben — quick notes from the infra side before we send final artifacts to Novacare: 

- API keys: recommend we provide a step-by-step script for ephemeral token rotation (curl example + TTL=15m). Ephemeral tokens remove the need for long-lived creds in the early POC. We'll still include a long-lived read-only token option but flag it as for monitoring only.
- Org invite: when we create the sandbox org, we should set the default retention to 30 days and call that out explicitly. If they need longer retention for eval logs we can extend per request but note cost implications.
- IP allowlist: include both the single egress IP block and the optional CIDR ranges for regionally proxied traffic. I can add sample /32 for immediate testing.
- VPC peering: we need their project number and VPC ID. Suggest we request an AWS account owner contact and GCP project owner contact in the kickoff so we avoid back-and-forth. Add a line in the MAP: "Please provide VPC ID + account/project number in the kickoff notes."

I'll update the vpc-peering-template.pdf with the IAM role names and a checkbox for "reverse DNS / route propagation verified". Ben — can you finish the API instructions and include the curl examples?

-Neha

--
Neha Kapoor
Head of Platform Security | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alyssa Romero <alyssa@novacare.io>
Cc: Novacare IT <it@novacare.io>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jun 2029 16:44:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick sync — POC MAP and connectivity items

Alyssa — thanks for the quick turnaround on confirming the kickoff. Per our internal review we've tightened the MAP timeline and clarified ownership. Please see the condensed action slate below (I also attached the three files we referenced):

Action slate (deliverables + owners / target date):
- Redwood: create sandbox org + send SSO invite to Novacare admin — Owner: Tessa / ETA: 2029-06-12 EOD (done; invite sent).
- Redwood: API key scripts (ephemeral + read-only example) — Owner: Ben / ETA: 2029-06-13 10:00 PT (attached: onramp-api-key-instructions.md).
- Novacare IT: confirm public egress IP(s) and provide VPC IDs / project numbers for peering — Owner: Novacare IT / Requested by: 2029-06-14 17:00 PT.
- Joint: VPC peering kickoff (technical working session) — Proposed: 2029-06-14 09:00 PT. RSVP in the calendar invite I'll send once you confirm.
- Compliance packet: SOC2 evaluation stub + POC retention note (30d default) — Owner: Neha / Delivered at kickoff.

To keep the POC tight we propose this cadence: 2-week pilot (functional verification) followed by a 4-week evaluation period for load and metrics. If all good, we can move to an expansion sprint.

Meeting options: Tue 6/11 10:00 PT (still open) or Fri 6/14 09:00 PT for the VPC technical kickoff. Which do you prefer? I'll send invites for both slots and you can accept the one that fits.

Attachments referenced: MAP-activation-slides.pdf (concise MAP + milestones), onramp-api-key-instructions.md (curl examples + TTL guidance), vpc-peering-template.pdf (required IDs & IAM checks). Links: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4987, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1FfExampleMapFolder

If that all looks good we can mark the MAP as committed and start the org provisioning immediately.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
